entities.name: PMID:39967763
observations: Prospective cohort of 25 patients with mature post-burn hypertrophic scars treated with four fractional CO2 laser sessions; VSS vascularity decreased from 0.85 ± 1.085 to 0.10 ± 0.300 (P < .001).

entities.name: Mature burn scar vascularity improves
observations: In a prospective cohort of 25 patients, fractional CO2 laser treatment was followed by VSS vascularity reduction from 0.85 ± 1.085 to 0.10 ± 0.300 (P < .001). This is a clinical rating, not direct vascular imaging.

entities.name: Fractional CO2 laser
observations: Ablative fractional carbon dioxide laser was administered in four sessions at 4–6-week intervals in the prospective mature post-burn hypertrophic scar cohort.

entities.name: Mature hypertrophic burn scar
observations: The prospective cohort evaluated mature post-burn hypertrophic scars and assessed vascularity using the Vancouver Scar Scale.
